papers.title: Target-Guided Selective Reweighting for physics-informed neural network inverse problems: A transfer learning approach

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文提出面向PINN反问题的目标引导选择性重加权与迁移学习框架，方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模与参数反演，但未涉及植入物或接触力学。
llm.why_not_core: It targets generic PINN inverse problems with no FEA surrogate benchmark, no implant/biomechanics application, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN求解反问题时损失项权重难平衡、收敛慢。
summary_zh.method: 用目标引导的选择性重加权结合迁移学习训练PINN反演。
summary_zh.result: 在基准反问题上提升了精度与训练稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例基准测试，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks struggle with ill-conditioned loss balancing when solving inverse problems.
summary_en.method: A target-guided selective reweighting scheme is coupled with transfer learning to train PINNs for inverse parameter identification.
summary_en.result: The approach improves inversion accuracy and training stability on benchmark inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on numerical benchmark inverse problems without experimental or biomechanical validation.

papers.title: Effects of post-build heat treatments on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Monel 400 processed through laser powder bed fusion

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究Monel 400镍铜合金的LPBF成形与热处理，属于增材制造工艺-组织-性能关系，与生物医学植入物方向仅有间接的工艺背景关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies a Ni-Cu alloy (Monel 400) with no biomedical implant context, no porous structure or stiffness-matching analysis, no osseointegration, and no fatigue or bone-implant interface evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究后处理热处理对LPBF成形Monel 400组织与性能的调控作用。
summary_zh.method: 对激光粉末床熔融Monel 400试样施加不同热处理制度，表征显微组织并测试力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著改变晶粒与析出相形貌，进而影响强度与塑性匹配。
summary_zh.validation: 显微组织表征与室温力学性能测试。

summary_en.motivation: Post-build heat treatment is expected to tailor the microstructure and mechanical response of laser powder bed fused Monel 400.
summary_en.method: LPBF-fabricated Monel 400 specimens were subjected to varied heat treatment schedules, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical property testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment altered grain morphology and precipitate characteristics, thereby modifying the strength-ductility balance.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization combined with room-temperature mechanical testing.

papers.title: Water-Balance Physics-Informed Neural Network for Daily Streamflow Prediction: A Single-Catchment Comparative Study Using CAMELS-GB v2
papers.abstract: Accurate daily streamflow prediction remains challenging because rainfall–runoff dynamics are nonlinear, temporally dependent, and subject to water-mass conservation. This study examines whether a simplified catchment water-balance constraint improves the internal consistency of a physics-informed neural network (WB-PINN) without compromising predictive accuracy. Using 18,993 daily observations (1970–2022) from Catchment 31010 in CAMELS-GB v2, the WB-PINN jointly estimates discharge, latent storage, and an evapotranspiration scaling factor. Its loss function combines prediction error with a water-balance residual weighted by λ. We evaluated performance on a chronological independent test period (2012–2022) against Ridge regression, support vector regression, XGBoost, a multilayer perceptron, and an LSTM. We tested five physics-loss weights and additional regularization controls to distinguish physical constraints from generic regularization effects. At λ = 0.001, mean validation water-balance loss decreased from 13.69 to 8.22, with nearly unchanged accuracy (NSE 0.8419 versus 0.8433 without the constraint). On the test set, LSTM performed best (NSE 0.8673; RMSE 0.3772 mm/day), while WB-PINN ranked second numerically (NSE 0.8209; RMSE 0.4381 mm/day). Paired bootstrap analysis found no statistically significant differences between WB-PINN and XGBoost or support vector regression, whereas LSTM achieved lower RMSE and higher NSE. Removing antecedent discharge reduced accuracy across all models. Because storage and actual evapotranspiration were unobserved, reduced residuals do not establish hydrological realism. Test-period diagnostics revealed a persistent mean water-balance residual of −0.7070 mm/day and predicted evapotranspiration substantially below the long-term water-balance estimate. Thus, weak water-balance regularization reduced the imposed residual with little loss of predictive accuracy but did not achieve close water-balance closure or outperform the strongest data-driven model.
papers.venue: International Journal of Hydrological and Environmental for Sustainability

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文将物理约束PINN用于水文径流预测，仅可作为PINN约束损失设计的背景参考，与植入物力学或FEA代理建模无直接关系。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies a water-balance PINN to hydrological streamflow forecasting with no FEA, no solid mechanics, no implant biomechanics, and no surrogate modeling of structural simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 检验简化水量平衡约束能否提升PINN内部一致性而不损失预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 构建联合估计径流、隐储量与蒸散缩放因子的水量平衡PINN，并与多种机器学习模型对比。
summary_zh.result: 弱物理正则降低了水量平衡残差但精度略降，未超越LSTM且未实现水量平衡闭合。
summary_zh.validation: 基于CAMELS-GB单一流域1970–2022日观测的时间序列独立测试与配对自助法。

summary_en.motivation: The study asks whether a simplified catchment water-balance constraint can improve the internal consistency of a physics-informed neural network without degrading predictive skill.
summary_en.method: A water-balance PINN jointly estimates discharge, latent storage, and an evapotranspiration scaling factor, with a weighted balance residual added to the prediction loss and benchmarked against Ridge, SVR, XGBoost, MLP, and LSTM models.
summary_en.result: Weak physics regularization reduced the imposed balance residual with nearly unchanged accuracy, yet the model did not achieve water-balance closure and ranked below LSTM on the independent test period.
summary_en.validation: Chronological hold-out testing on 18,993 daily observations from a single CAMELS-GB catchment, supplemented by paired bootstrap comparisons and physics-weight sensitivity analysis.

papers.title: Enhanced compressive performance of LPBF AlSi10Mg lattice structures via PA12 and epoxy infiltration

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究LPBF晶格结构的聚合物浸渗增强压缩性能，与增材制造生物医学多孔支架的力学强化思路可迁移，但材料为AlSi10Mg而非钛合金或生物医用材料。
llm.why_not_core: Uses AlSi10Mg and PA12/epoxy infiltration with no biomedical implant context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface morphology assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: LPBF晶格结构承载能力有限，需后处理强化。
summary_zh.method: 对AlSi10Mg晶格进行PA12与环氧树脂浸渗并做压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 浸渗显著提升晶格结构的压缩强度与吸能性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: As-built LPBF lattice structures often exhibit limited load-bearing capacity, motivating post-processing reinforcement strategies.
summary_en.method: AlSi10Mg lattice specimens fabricated by LPBF were infiltrated with PA12 and epoxy and subsequently characterized under compression.
summary_en.result: Polymer infiltration markedly improved the compressive strength and energy absorption of the lattice structures.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation relied on quasi-static compression testing of fabricated lattice specimens.

papers.title: Time to first rescue opioid analgesia after perineural versus intravenous dexamethasone for PENG block in older adults undergoing total hip arthroplasty: a randomized double-blind trial

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究全髋关节置换术后PENG阻滞中地塞米松给药途径的镇痛效果，与股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或骨-假体界面力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a clinical anesthesia/analgesia trial with no biomechanical modeling, no femoral stem stress shielding, no micromotion or contact mechanics, and no FEA boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较神经周围与静脉地塞米松对老年全髋置换患者PENG阻滞镇痛时效的差异。
summary_zh.method: 随机双盲试验，记录首次补救阿片类镇痛时间作为主要结局。
summary_zh.result: 评估两种给药途径对术后镇痛持续时间的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether perineural dexamethasone prolongs PENG block analgesia compared with intravenous administration in older adults undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized double-blind trial measuring time to first rescue opioid analgesia as the primary outcome.
summary_en.result: The study compares analgesic duration between the two dexamethasone delivery routes.
summary_en.validation: Clinical randomized controlled trial in human patients.
